name: us.fo
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 351 images have no alt attribute.
lesson: Describe what each image shows in its alt attribute, and use alt="" on purely decorative ones.
summary: www.us.fo scores 67 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 31 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 64 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /english/, /category/tidindi/, /stovnurin/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 351 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 18 elements on /, /english/, /category/tidindi/, for example .header-logo and .header-search. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 11 elements on /, /english/, /category/tidindi/, for example .wp-block-button > a[href$="tidindi/"] and .post-simple--item:nth-child(1) > .post-date. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

Plain http redirects permanently to https
